description: List the ready-made city digital twins (Barcelona, Helsinki, Tokyo): georeferenced IFC models on terrain and the OpenStreetMap city, painted with live open data (bikes, EV chargers, traffic, air quality, trains). Each has a link and an embed link. Also returns the link to the twin builder, where the user builds their own twin (AGV warehouse, import tracking) from a CSV or live feed. Use it when the user asks for a digital twin demo or wants to start one.
name: list_digital_twins
title: List live digital twin scenes
